title: Party pickers filter as the trader types
detail: With JavaScript, the address book list re-requests itself as the trader types in the search field or changes the Type select, after a short pause, and swaps in the table, the results line and the pagination without a full page load, so a trader narrows a long book without pressing a button. It enhances the search form that already works without JavaScript. It waits on design and the product owner answering the live-filtering question, and is built as they answer or dropped if the behaviour is dropped. With JavaScript, narrows a party picker's one-page list as the trader types, with no page reload, on both animals sets' five pickers and on the high-risk plants frontend's consignor and place of destination pickers, so a trader with a long address book finds the right record without a round trip. The place of origin picker narrows by country as well, as the trader types or picks one. It waits on design: until design, with the product owner, answers the open question on live filtering, the server search behind the submitting search button is the whole search. It is built as design answers, or dropped if design drops it.
acceptanceCriteria: With JavaScript on, typing in the address book list's search field or changing its Type select updates, after a short pause and without a full page load, the table, the results line and the pagination to the matches, with no apply button to press (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p16-026, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p16-027; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-067; c-169)

With JavaScript off, the same search field and Type select narrow the list when the search button or Enter submits the form, and the results line and pagination describe the matches (repo:insfrontend repo-insfrontend-p2-005; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-053, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-054; c-169)

With JavaScript on, typing in the search box of a live-animals or germinal products party picker shows, with no page reload, only the rows whose name, address lines or country contain the typed text, ignoring case, and the results count shows how many are on screen (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p8-057; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p6-074, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p6-075, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p6-076; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p3-054; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-067)

The high-risk plants consignor and place of destination pickers narrow the same way as the trader types (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-050, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-042; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p6-004)

With JavaScript on, typing in or picking a country on the place of origin picker shows, with no page reload, only the rows whose country contains the typed text or exactly matches the picked country, on both animals sets (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p8-055; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p9-055, repo-frontend-p9-070; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-070)
Clearing the search box shows every row of the role's list again, and the results count returns to the full total (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p6-102)

With JavaScript turned off, each picker's submitting search button still narrows the list on the server, as it does today (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-066; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p9-070)

sources.ref: ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-044, p1-046, p1-047, p1-052 to p1-054, p1-063, p1-067 (the JavaScript half is its own increment, waiting on design question 5 with the party pickers' live row filter)
repo-insfrontend-p2-005 (today the list changes only when the search form is submitted)

openQuestions: Design, with the product owner, must answer the live-filtering question (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm, design question 5, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-052, p1-053, p1-063, p1-067) before this builds; if design drops the behaviour, this row is dropped. Until then the server search behind the submit button is the whole search.

Design, with the product owner, must answer the open question on filtering a list as the trader types before this builds; if design drops it, this row is dropped. Until then the server search behind each picker's submitting search button is the whole search (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-052, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-053, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-063, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-067).

Design must also answer the open question on the place of origin picker's filtering as the trader types, which goes to the product owner alongside the one above (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-070).
notes: Combines the drafts of the address-book-list, consignment-parties areas for this row: they change the same pages, record and journey, so building them apart would repeat the same set-up, review and ladder.

This area's only share of the existing blocked row inc-193 (party pickers filter as the trader types), which already holds req-2039. Combiner: merge this into inc-193 with the consignment-parties area's draft, keeping inc-193's id, its waiting-on-design theme and its frontend, plantsfrontend and tests entries, because ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-067 puts the address book list's live filter and the party pickers' live row filter in one design increment. Still blocked: the 26 October ruling says nothing about live filtering. The second criterion keeps the no-JavaScript search that the search row builds working, which is what makes this an enhancement rather than a replacement. The existing row's note observes that this criterion could reuse the server-rendered live-search pattern on the unmerged address book search branch if that branch merges first; that stays a plan matter. Waits on the address book split branch's search row (externalDependsOn on shared/design-release-2-1/themes/address-book inc-069), whose GET form it enhances.

Re-drafted on this re-distil from existing row inc-193. Both requirements still carry a blocker, so the row stays blocked. Combines the four party pickers' filter and the place of origin picker's country filter, because ruling sam-2026-10-09-pm puts them in one waiting-on-design increment and they are one client module on one results table. Client-side code is new: neither frontend's picker carries JavaScript today. Depends on the role-filtered pickers row (one page to filter, and the results count it updates) and on the germinal set's pickers, because req-592 names both animals sets. CARRY OVER: the existing row inc-193 also holds req-2039 (the INS address book list re-requesting itself as the trader types), the address-book-list area's, and the insfrontend repo key with it; this draft leaves both for the combiner to carry over with inc-193's id. Build note: the animals transporter list already filters as you type, with shared accent-folding and bold-match helpers under frontend:src/client/common/helpers; build the picker filter from those rather than a new one. In plants the three pickers share features/address-book-picker, so one change covers the consignor, place of destination and contact pickers. The transporter list's own in-page filter is not this row's. Theme: waiting-on-design.
